verify.egressHint: One way out for requests: the browser’s own fetch on the web, the host on the desktop. A browser is bound by its origin; another origin must allow it.
verify.hintClient: These abilities come from the desktop shell; a browser has no host
verify.hostHint: These come from the desktop shell: credential store, system integration, pickers, opening the browser. A browser has no host, so the buttons answer "no host".
verify.serviceAddressHint: On the desktop the user types or picks it, and the host holds it (it survives restarts); the address is never baked into the artifact. The host checks an address before saving it, and the service document is still read by the application, the same way on both clients.
